name: agent-broker
description: 14 MCP tools to find, verify, message, and book appointments at small businesses worldwide. Built-in TCPA/GDPR/CASL compliance. Turns any Cal.com, Calendly, Doctolib, Booksy, OpenTable, Setmore, Square, Acuity, Schedulista, Squarespace, Fresha, or BookMyCity URL into a bookable SMB in one tool call.

auth.note: Read-only operations and find_business require no auth. State-changing operations require an X-Agent-Identity bearer token.
